mapper.update: CREATE TABLE ${tableName} ( IMG_KEY character varying(40) NOT NULL, REQ_DATE timestamp, IMG_STATUS character varying(10), CHANNEL character varying(10), FILE_ID character varying(40) NOT NULL, FILE_URL character varying(200), METADATA_HASH_CODE character varying(11), WIDE_YN character varying(1), IMG_PATH character varying(200), IMG_URL character varying(200), REG_DATE timestamp, EXP_DATE timestamp, DONE_CODE character varying(10), DONE_CODE_DESC character varying(200), DONE_DATE timestamp, CONSTRAINT PK_${tableName} PRIMARY KEY (IMG_KEY) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${tableName} ( IMG_KEY, REQ_DATE, IMG_STATUS, CHANNEL, FILE_ID, METADATA_HASH_CODE, WIDE_YN, IMG_PATH, IMG_URL ) VALUES ( #{parameter.key}, NOW(), #{parameter.imageStatus}, #{parameter.channel}, #{parameter.fileId}, #{parameter.metadataHashCode}, #{parameter.wideYn}, #{parameter.imagePath}, #{parameter.imageUrl} )
mapper.select: SELECT /* +RULE*/ IMG_KEY AS key, CHANNEL, FILE_ID, METADATA_HASH_CODE AS metadata_hash_code, WIDE_YN, IMG_PATH AS image_path, IMG_URL AS image_url FROM ${tableName} WHERE IMG_STATUS = 'ready' AND REQ_DATE < NOW() LIMIT 100
SELECT IMG_KEY AS key FROM ${tableName} WHERE IMG_STATUS = 'request' AND REQ_DATE < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 seconds' LIMIT 100
SELECT IMG_KEY AS key, METADATA_HASH_CODE FROM ${tableName} WHERE IMG_STATUS = 'complete' AND EXP_DATE < NOW() LIMIT 100

SELECT IMG_KEY AS key, IMG_STATUS AS image_status, FILE_ID, TO_CHAR(EXP_DATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS expire_date, DONE_CODE FROM ${tableName} WHERE METADATA_HASH_CODE = #{metadataHashCode} ORDER BY EXP_DATE DESC LIMIT 1
